title: Cohomology is unchanged by pushforward along a closed immersion
statement: Let i:Z\to X be a continuous map that is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset of X, and let F be an abelian sheaf on Z. Define (i_*F)(U)=F(i^{-1}U) for each open U of X. For every integer p>=0, there is a natural isomorphism H^p(Z,F) \cong H^p(X,i_*F), where cohomology is [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].
